How to Care for Full Grain Leather

Why conditioning matters

Leather is a hide, and a hide dries out.

How often to condition

Daily carry items

Twice a year is enough for a wallet.

Bags and belts

Once a year unless it gets soaked.

What to avoid

Never use mink oil on veg-tan.

Repairing scratches

Most surface marks buff out with a thumb.
